title: evidence
description: The role borne by the two components of a twist-product value: a pair tracking positive evidence (for an assertion) and negative evidence (against) as independently aggregated sides, never collapsed into one signed scalar. Generated by the four-bilattice as the structural content of its values.

positive.description: the first coordinate a_+ of <a_+, a_-> in L_1 x L_2: information for the assertion

negative.description: the second coordinate a_- of <a_+, a_-> in L_1 x L_2: information against the assertion

independence.description: the two sides are separately representable, so 'no evidence for p' is distinguishable from 'evidence against p'

compatibility.description: both sides may hold at once without trivializing inference, licensing the value top = <1,1> as contradiction held as a state rather than ex falso

transverse-aggregation.description: the two sides aggregate separately: more positive evidence raises a_+ leaving a_- fixed and vice versa, via the knowledge-order join \vee_k
